name: Clara Pacini
bio: Clara Pacini (born 2002) is a French actress who made her feature film debut in Lucile Hadžihalilović's The Ice Tower (2025).

credits.title: Tout le monde se casse la gueule
credits.overview: Today, everyone is falling flat on their face. Some fall for good. Others pretend to. Clara, for her part, is only trying to understand what is expected of her when someone falls right in front of her eyes.

credits.title: One Minute to Midnight
credits.overview: As he is about to separate from his partner, with whom he lives in Eastern France, 49-year-old Léo learns of the death of his biological father whom he never knew. credits.title: there’s always something missing (especially when you don’t know what to look for)
credits.overview: Abraham finishes a concert in front of an almost empty venue. As he’s packing up his equipment, a woman calls out to him: he’s forgotten something on stage. Unfortunately, Abraham doesn’t see what she’s talking about and the stage is empty. Thus begins a strange nocturnal wandering in search of that something.

credits.title: The Ice Tower
credits.overview: Jeanne, a 15-year-old orphan, witnesses the shoot for a film adaptation of the fairy tale The Snow Queen, and she becomes fascinated by its star, Cristina, an actress who is just as mysterious and alluring as the Queen she is playing.

credits.title: Club Cauchemar
credits.overview: Sarah is invited to join the club tonight. As the rain of the storm beats on the roof, a group of teenagers gather in a large house to sleep all together. They install the sheets of large beds, then all fall asleep, close to each other.
